overview.title: SMS Technology Evolution
overview.description: From simple text transmission in 2G to today's RCS rich messaging, SMS technology has undergone profound transformation. Modern enterprise SMS integrates dynamic links, brand verification, and two-way interaction. The A2P SMS market is projected to exceed $78 billion by 2028.

trends.title: Industry Trends
trends.description: RCS rich messaging gradually replacing traditional SMS; 10DLC becoming new US A2P standard; OTP remains mainstream for account security; AI-driven smart routing and semantic replies reshaping the industry.

ai.title: AI-Powered SMS

business.title: Business Value

global.title: Global Deployment
global.description: 30+ data center nodes globally with direct carrier interconnections. Local number sending builds user trust. Intelligent routing algorithms ensure fast, reliable delivery to every corner of the world.
